title: Sign-cube combination with a fixed head
statement: For every natural number $n$, every sign vector $x$ of length $n$, and every assignment $z$ of signs to the coordinate $0$ in a sign cube of dimension $n+1$, combine the signs of $x$ on coordinates $1,\ldots,n$ with $z$ at coordinate $0$. The resulting sign vector is the vector with first coordinate $z(0)$ and remaining coordinates given by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a sign vector of length n
z assigns a sign to the sole fixed coordinate 0 in dimension n+1
